text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm on my way to my office when I overhear some mumbling.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Big carrots plus ice cream… equals present progressive tense…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm juuust about finished with my… extra homework…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I have a hard time remembering grammar rules, so I'm using food as examples!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: If I conjugate big carrots, then ice cream should be…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Uh… I'll just write down, "I like carrot ice cream."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara's strange technique doesn't help her remember any grammar rules, so she has to take even more extra classes… leading to exhaustion.
